artist.name: Fontaines D.C.
artist.profile:
Irish indie rock/post-punk band from Dublin, formed in 2014 as Fontaines (with original guitarist Josh O'Connor).
 
Band members: 
Grian Chatten (vocals)
Conor Deegan III (bass)
Carlos O’Connell (guitar)
Conor Curley (guitar)
Tom Coll (drums)
